dict.string: Health Dashboard sets a backup alarm on your iPhone at your smart alarm's latest time, in case your Watch can't wake you.

Health Dashboard looks for exams on your calendar (events with exam, midterm, final, quiz or test in the title) so it can plan your sleep around them. It never changes your calendar, and events stay on your phone.

Reads your sleep, heart rate, HRV, daylight, steps, wrist temperature and cycle data to learn your sleep need, best wake time and energy curve, and, if you turn it on, the pill doses you log so a pill you've taken gets no reminder. Everything stays on your phone.
Saves the caffeine and water you log to Apple Health.
With the Sky theme, your rough location (city level) works out today's sunrise and sunset on your phone, so the app's colours follow the sun. It's never sent anywhere.
